hostname hq-acc-sw-01
!
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
username admin privilege 15 algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
!
vlan 10
 name USERS
vlan 30
 name IOT-CAMERAS
!
interface Vlan99
 ip address 10.10.99.11 255.255.255.0
!

 switchport access vlan 30
 switchport mode access
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip ssh version 2
logging host 10.10.20.50
no vstack
snmp-server community Xk29!mon RO MGMT-ONLY
!
line vty 0 15
 access-class MGMT-ONLY in
 transport input ssh
!
